chunks.en: The ability of single grain boundaries in YBa[[MATH_14]]Cu[[MATH_15]]O[[MATH_16]] bicrystalline rings to carry electrical current is found to be significantly enhanced under hydrostatic pressure. Nearly hydrostatic pressures are applied to the alkali metals Li, Na, and K. in a search for superconductivity. \ Whereas Li becomes superconducting above 20 GPa at temperatures as high as 15 K, no superconductivity was observed above 4 K in Na to 65 GPa nor in K above 4 K to 43.5 GPa or above 1.5 K to 35 GPa.
chunks.zh: 研究发现，YBa[[MATH_14]]Cu[[MATH_15]]O[[MATH_16]] 双晶环中单个晶界承载电流的能力在静水压力下显著增强。为寻找超导电性，对碱金属 Li、Na 和 K 施加了近似静水压力。\ Li 在 20 GPa 以上、温度高达 15 K 时变为超导体，而 Na 在 65 GPa 以下、4 K 以上未观察到超导电性，K 在 43.5 GPa 以下、4 K 以上以及 35 GPa 以下、1.5 K 以上也未观察到超导电性。

chunks.en: Introduction
chunks.zh: 引言

chunks.en: The first high pressure experiments on a superconductor were carried out in 1925 by Sizoo and Onnes [[CITE_17]], 14 years after the discovery of the first superconductor [[CITE_18]]. Since then high-pressure investigations have had an important impact on the field. Following the discovery of a new superconductor, one of the first experiments is to determine the pressure dependence of the superconducting transition temperature [[MATH_19]] If the magnitude of [[MATH_20]] is large, one can have good hope that higher values of [[MATH_21]] at ambient pressure are possible. In addition, a comparison of the pressure dependences of [[MATH_22]] with those of selected normal state properties provides information regarding the mechanism(s) responsible for the superconductivity, as recently illustrated for MgB[[MATH_23]], the high-[[MATH_24]] oxides, and the alkali-doped fullerenes [[CITE_25]].
chunks.zh: 首次对超导体进行的高压实验由 Sizoo 和 Onnes 于 1925 年完成 [[CITE_17]]，距第一种超导体的发现 [[CITE_18]] 已有 14 年。从那时起，高压研究对该领域产生了重要影响。在发现一种新的超导体之后，最先开展的实验之一便是测定超导转变温度 [[MATH_19]] 的压力依赖关系。如果 [[MATH_20]] 的量值较大，那么人们就有理由期待在环境压力下获得更高的 [[MATH_21]] 值。此外，将 [[MATH_22]] 的压力依赖关系与若干选定的正常态性质进行比较，可以为阐明导致超导的机制提供信息，正如最近对 MgB[[MATH_23]]、高 [[MATH_24]] 氧化物以及碱金属掺杂富勒烯所展示的那样 [[CITE_25]]。

chunks.en: In this paper we give further examples to illustrate how the high-pressure technique can provide vital information and uncover new physics for two completely different classes of superconductors: \ (1) the high-pressure enhancement of the critical current density [[MATH_26]] across a single grain boundary (GB) in bicrystalline rings of the high-[[MATH_27]] oxide YBa[[MATH_28]]Cu[[MATH_29]]O[[MATH_30]] (YBCO), and (2) pressure-induced superconductivity in the alkali metals. The observation of pressure-induced superconductivity in Li is at odds with the conventional wisdom that metals become more free-electron-like under pressure.
chunks.zh: 在本文中，我们给出更多实例，以说明高压技术如何能够为两类完全不同的超导体提供关键信息并揭示新的物理现象：\ (1) 高 [[MATH_27]] 氧化物 YBa[[MATH_28]]Cu[[MATH_29]]O[[MATH_30]]（YBCO）双晶环中跨越单个晶界（GB）的临界电流密度 [[MATH_26]] 在高压下的增强；(2) 碱金属中由压力诱导的超导电性。在 Li 中观测到的压力诱导超导电性与传统观点相悖，后者认为金属在压力下会变得更具自由电子特征。

chunks.en: Results on YBCO Grain Boundaries
chunks.zh: YBCO 晶界上的结果

chunks.en: Shortly after the discovery of the high-[[MATH_31]] oxides in 1986 it became clear that the [[MATH_32]]-values for polycrystalline materials not only are vastly inferior to the those obtained in single crystalline samples, but also degrade sharply in a magnetic field [[CITE_33]]. Experiments on epitaxially-grown YBCO thin films demonstrated that this strong degradation in [[MATH_34]] resulted from the presence of grain boundaries in the polycrystals [[CITE_35]]; for adjacent grains with parallel [[MATH_36]]-axes, [[MATH_37]] was found to decrease roughly exponentially with increasing misorientation angle [[MATH_38]] [[CITE_39]]. Pinpointing the mechanisms behind this [[MATH_40]] degradation and developing strategies to enhance [[MATH_41]] to the values needed for many applications have been at the focus of intensive research for many years.
chunks.zh: 在1986年高 [[MATH_31]] 氧化物被发现后不久，人们就清楚地认识到，多晶材料的 [[MATH_32]] 值不仅远远逊于单晶样品所获得的值，而且在磁场中还会急剧退化 [[CITE_33]]。对外延生长的 YBCO 薄膜的实验表明，[[MATH_34]] 的这种强烈退化源于多晶中晶界的存在 [[CITE_35]]；对于 [[MATH_36]] 轴平行的相邻晶粒，人们发现 [[MATH_37]] 随取向差角 [[MATH_38]] 的增大而近似呈指数下降 [[CITE_39]]。查明这种 [[MATH_40]] 退化背后的机制，并开发将 [[MATH_41]] 提升至许多应用所需值的策略，多年来一直是深入研究的重点。

chunks.en: Possible candidates for the [[MATH_42]] degradation include various types of imperfections in or at the GB such as site disorder, lattice strains, and oxygen vacancies [[CITE_43]]. High-pressure experiments may shed some light on these matters by modifying the conditions at the GB in several different ways: \ (1) reduction of tunneling barrier width, (2) varying the degree of lattice strain, (3) enhancing the degree of oxygen ordering in the GB, in analogy with the well studied pressure-induced oxygen ordering effects in the bulk [[CITE_44]]. The very existence of relaxation effects due to oxygen ordering in the GB would signal that the oxygen sublattice is only partially full and thus capable of accepting further oxygen doping.
chunks.zh: [[MATH_42]] 退化的可能成因包括晶界（GB）内部或界面处的各种缺陷，例如位点无序、晶格应变以及氧空位 [[CITE_43]]。高压实验可以通过多种不同方式改变晶界处的条件，从而为这些问题提供一些启示：\ （1）减小隧穿势垒宽度，（2）改变晶格应变的程度，（3）增强晶界中氧有序的程度，类似于体内已被广泛研究的压力诱导氧有序效应 [[CITE_44]]。晶界中由氧有序引起的弛豫效应的存在本身将表明氧亚晶格仅被部分填充，因而能够接受进一步的氧掺杂。

chunks.en: Previous [[MATH_45]] susceptibility studies on bulk polycrystalline samples of YBa[[MATH_46]]Cu[[MATH_47]]O[[MATH_48]] and Tl[[MATH_49]]CaBa[[MATH_50]]Cu[[MATH_51]]O[[MATH_52]] indicated that the bulk [[MATH_53]] was enhanced through pressure, but it was not possible to extract detailed information [[CITE_54]]. Studies of pressure-dependent effects for a single grain boundary are clearly needed. Such experiments have recently become possible with the availability of bicrystalline rings of YBa[[MATH_55]]Cu[[MATH_56]]O[[MATH_57]] with varying misorientation angles [[MATH_58]] and oxygen content [[MATH_59]] [[CITE_60]].
chunks.zh: 先前对 YBa[[MATH_46]]Cu[[MATH_47]]O[[MATH_48]] 和 Tl[[MATH_49]]CaBa[[MATH_50]]Cu[[MATH_51]]O[[MATH_52]] 块体多晶样品的 [[MATH_45]] 磁化率研究表明，体 [[MATH_53]] 可通过加压得到提升，但无法提取详细信息 [[CITE_54]]。显然需要针对单个晶界的压力依赖效应开展研究。随着具有不同取向差角 [[MATH_58]] 和氧含量 [[MATH_59]] 的 YBa[[MATH_55]]Cu[[MATH_56]]O[[MATH_57]] 双晶环的问世，此类实验近来已成为可能 [[CITE_60]]。

chunks.en: The He-gas pressure cell (Unipress) suitable for hydrostatic pressure studies to 1.4 GPa is shown in Fig. 1. The YBCO bicrystalline ring with typical dimensions 5 mm O.D. x 3 mm I.D. x 1 mm is mounted in the sample holder made of Vespel which is placed in the 7 mm bore of the BeCu pressure cell. An alumina cylinder is positioned above the sample holder to reduce the volume of He in the cell.
chunks.zh: 适用于高达 1.4 GPa 静水压研究的 He 气压力池（Unipress）如图 1 所示。典型尺寸为外径 5 mm × 内径 3 mm × 厚度 1 mm 的 YBCO 双晶环安装在由 Vespel 制成的样品架上，该样品架置于 BeCu 压力池 7 mm 的内孔中。在样品架上方放置一个氧化铝圆柱体，以减少池内 He 的体积。

chunks.en: Two counterwound pickup coils are used in the [[MATH_61]] susceptibility measurement,\ one positioned around the YBCO ring, the other 2.3 mm below. To vary the temperature over the range 6 - 300 K the pressure cell is placed in the sample tube of a closed-cycle refrigerator (Balzers) with the BeCu capillary tube (3 mm O.D. x 0.3 mm I.D.) exiting out the top and connected to a three-stage He-gas compressor system (Harwood) to 1.4 GPa with a digital manganin gauge. Since primary [[MATH_62]] field amplitudes as high as 300 G are required, internal heating effects are avoided by removing the field coil from the pressure cell and placing it outside the tail piece of the cryostat. To ensure full field penetration to the sample, the frequency of the [[MATH_63]] field was reduced to 1 Hz. Standard [[MATH_64]] susceptibility techniques are used with a SR830 digital lockin amplifier.
chunks.zh: 在 [[MATH_61]] 磁化率测量中使用了两个反向绕制的拾取线圈，\ 一个环绕在 YBCO 环周围，另一个位于其下方 2.3 mm 处。为在 6 - 300 K 范围内改变温度，将压力池置于闭循环制冷机（Balzers）的样品管中，BeCu 毛细管（外径 3 mm × 内径 0.3 mm）从顶部引出，并连接至三级氦气压缩机系统（Harwood），压力可达 1.4 GPa，由数字锰铜压力计测量。由于需要高达 300 G 的初级 [[MATH_62]] 场振幅，为避免内部加热效应，将场线圈从压力池中移出，置于低温恒温器尾件之外。为确保磁场完全穿透至样品，将 [[MATH_63]] 场的频率降低至 1 Hz。采用标准的 [[MATH_64]] 磁化率测量技术，并使用 SR830 数字锁相放大器。

chunks.en: In Fig. 2 (left) the real part of the [[MATH_65]] susceptibility [[MATH_66]] is plotted versus temperature for an [[MATH_67]] field amplitude of 1 G at both ambient and 0.6 GPa hydrostatic pressure. The sample studied is a YBa[[MATH_68]]Cu[[MATH_69]]O[[MATH_70]] bicrystalline ring with misorientation angle [[MATH_71]] At temperatures below 88 K at ambient pressure, the applied flux is not able to penetrate into the ring since the induced current density through the two grain boundaries in the ring lies below the critical value [[MATH_72]] . Since [[MATH_73]] decreases monotonically with increasing temperature, as the temperature is raised, a value [[MATH_74]] K is reached where flux begins to penetrate through the weaker of the two grain boundaries into the interior of the ring; this leads to a sharp break in both the real and imaginary parts of [[MATH_75]] (see vertical arrow in Fig. 2 (left)) at the kink temperature [[MATH_76]] As the temperature is increased further, additional flux penetrates into the center of the ring, but not through the superconducting material of the ring itself, until a plateau is reached above 90 K. Above 91.7 K magnetic flux begins to penetrate into the ring material until above 92 K all superconductivity has been destroyed and the flux distribution is uniform. These results from [[MATH_77]] susceptibility measurements are in excellent agreement with parallel [[MATH_78]] susceptibility measurements using a SQUID magnetometer on the same YBCO ring.
chunks.zh: 在图 2（左）中，绘制了在环境压力和 0.6 GPa 静水压力下、[[MATH_67]] 场振幅为 1 G 时 [[MATH_65]] 磁化率 [[MATH_66]] 的实部随温度的变化。所研究的样品是一个 YBa[[MATH_68]]Cu[[MATH_69]]O[[MATH_70]] 双晶环，其取向差角为 [[MATH_71]] 。在环境压力下温度低于 88 K 时，外加磁通无法穿入环内，因为通过环中两个晶界所感应的电流密度低于临界值 [[MATH_72]] 。由于 [[MATH_73]] 随温度升高而单调减小，当温度升高时，会达到某一数值 [[MATH_74]] K，此时磁通开始通过两个晶界中较弱的一个穿入环的内部；这导致 [[MATH_75]] 的实部和虚部在拐点温度 [[MATH_76]] 处均出现急剧的突变（见图 2（左）中的竖直箭头）。随着温度进一步升高，更多的磁通穿入环的中心，但并不穿过环本身的超导材料，直到在 90 K 以上达到一个平台。在 91.7 K 以上，磁通开始穿入环材料，直到 92 K 以上所有超导电性被破坏，磁通分布变为均匀。这些来自 [[MATH_77]] 磁化率测量的结果与使用 SQUID 磁强计对同一 YBCO 环进行的平行 [[MATH_78]] 磁化率测量结果高度一致。

chunks.en: The shielding current [[MATH_79]] around the ring is directly proportional to the field amplitude [[MATH_80]] [[MATH_81]] where,\ to a good approximation, [[MATH_82]] is the outer diameter of the ring [[CITE_83]]. In Fig. 2 (left) it is seen that under 0.6 GPa pressure [[MATH_84]] shifts to higher temperatures, i.e. [[MATH_85]] at a given temperature increases. This means that under hydrostatic pressure the ability of the GB to carry current is enhanced. This result is confirmed by further studies at magnetic field amplitudes to [[MATH_86]] 23 G which suppress [[MATH_87]] to temperatures below 20 K, as seen in Fig. 2 (right). In this figure the calculated values for [[MATH_88]] are given, where [[MATH_89]] and [[MATH_90]] is the cross-sectional area of the ring. At all measured temperatures [[MATH_91]] is seen to increase rapidly with hydrostatic pressure at the rate +26 \%/GPa which is much more rapid than that of [[MATH_92]] for the bulk material ([[MATH_93]] 0.24 \%/GPa).
chunks.zh: 环绕圆环的屏蔽电流 [[MATH_79]] 与场振幅 [[MATH_80]] 成正比，即 [[MATH_81]] ，其中，\ 在很好的近似下， [[MATH_82]] 为圆环的外径 [[CITE_83]] 。在图 2（左）中可以看到，在 0.6 GPa 压力下 [[MATH_84]] 向更高温度移动，即在给定温度下 [[MATH_85]] 增大。这意味着在静水压力下，GB 承载电流的能力得到增强。进一步的磁场振幅研究证实了这一结果，磁场振幅高达 [[MATH_86]] 23 G，将 [[MATH_87]] 抑制到 20 K 以下的温度，如图 2（右）所示。在该图中给出了 [[MATH_88]] 的计算值，其中 [[MATH_89]] ， [[MATH_90]] 为圆环的横截面积。在所有测量温度下，可以看到 [[MATH_91]] 随静水压力以 +26 \%/GPa 的速率快速增大，这远快于块体材料 [[MATH_92]] 的速率（ [[MATH_93]] 0.24 \%/GPa）。

chunks.en: We also find the change in [[MATH_94]] to be less if the pressure is varied at temperatures significantly below ambient; time dependences in [[MATH_95]] are also observed. Similar relaxation effects are well known in bulk YBCO where [[MATH_96]] is found to depend on the detailed pressure/temperature history of the sample [[CITE_97]]. The extreme sensitivity of these relaxation effects on the oxygen content points to the mobile oxygen ions in the basal plane, the ``chain layer'', as being their source. The bulk relaxation effects are smallest when the chain layer is fully developed and essentially all chain sites are filled, i.e. at the stoichiometry YBa[[MATH_98]]Cu[[MATH_99]]O[[MATH_100]]. In analogy, the relaxation effects observed in [[MATH_101]] for the GB give evidence that the GB contains a sizeable number of oxygen vacancies, i.e. there's room for more oxygen! If a way can be found to further enhance the oxygen concentration in the GB region, it is likely that higher values of [[MATH_102]] can be attained.
chunks.zh: 我们还发现，如果在远低于环境温度的条件下改变压力，[[MATH_94]] 的变化会更小；同时也观察到 [[MATH_95]] 中的时间依赖性。类似的弛豫效应在块体 YBCO 中已广为人知，其中 [[MATH_96]] 被发现取决于样品具体的压力/温度历史 [[CITE_97]]。这些弛豫效应对氧含量的极端敏感性表明，其来源是基面（即``链层''）中可移动的氧离子。当链层完全形成且几乎所有链位都被占据时，即在化学计量比 YBa[[MATH_98]]Cu[[MATH_99]]O[[MATH_100]] 处，块体弛豫效应最小。类似地，在 [[MATH_101]] 中观察到的晶界（GB）弛豫效应表明，GB 中含有相当数量的氧空位，也就是说还有容纳更多氧的空间！如果能找到一种方法进一步提高 GB 区域的氧浓度，则很可能获得更高的 [[MATH_102]] 值。

chunks.en: Further research is underway to determine the dependence of [[MATH_103]] on pressure as a function of both temperature and [[MATH_104]] magnetic field over a wide range of oxygen content and misorientation angle [[MATH_105]] [[CITE_106]].
chunks.zh: 进一步的研究正在进行中，以确定 [[MATH_103]] 对压力的依赖关系随温度和 [[MATH_104]] 磁场的变化，研究覆盖较宽范围的氧含量和取向差角 [[MATH_105]] [[CITE_106]]。

chunks.en: Results on Alkali Metals
chunks.zh: 碱金属上的结果

chunks.en: The nearly free electron picture works best for simple [[MATH_107]]-electron metals such as the alkali metals or noble metals. If a simple metal happens to be superconducting at ambient pressure (e.g. Pb, In, Sn, Al), [[MATH_108]] is invariably found to \textit{decrease} under hydrostatic pressure. This result has a simple explanation [[CITE_109]]. According to the well-known McMillan formula, [[MATH_110]] depends exponentially on the electron-phonon coupling parameter [[MATH_111]] where [[MATH_112]] is a purely electronic term, the Hopfield parameter, and [[MATH_113]] is a mean ``spring constant'' for the lattice. If [[MATH_114]] decreases, so does [[MATH_115]] The reason for the universal decrease in [[MATH_116]] under pressure for simple metals is that [[MATH_117]] increases much more rapidly than does [[MATH_118]] Another way to express this is that [[MATH_119]] decreases under pressure due to lattice stiffening. In transition metals the increase of [[MATH_120]] with pressure is comparable to that of [[MATH_121]] so that [[MATH_122]] may increase or decrease.
chunks.zh: 近自由电子图像最适用于简单的 [[MATH_107]] 电子金属，例如碱金属或贵金属。如果一种简单金属恰好在常压下是超导体（例如 Pb、In、Sn、Al），那么 [[MATH_108]] 在静水压力下总是被发现\textit{降低}。这一结果有一个简单的解释 [[CITE_109]]。根据著名的 McMillan 公式，[[MATH_110]] 指数地依赖于电声耦合参数 [[MATH_111]]，其中 [[MATH_112]] 是一个纯电子项，即 Hopfield 参数，而 [[MATH_113]] 是晶格的平均``弹性常数''。如果 [[MATH_114]] 减小，[[MATH_115]] 也随之减小。简单金属的 [[MATH_116]] 在压力下普遍减小的原因是 [[MATH_117]] 的增长远快于 [[MATH_118]]。另一种表述方式是，由于晶格硬化，[[MATH_119]] 在压力下减小。在过渡金属中，[[MATH_120]] 随压力的增长与 [[MATH_121]] 相当，因此 [[MATH_122]] 可能增大也可能减小。

chunks.en: Since for simple-metal superconductors [[MATH_123]] always \textit{decreases} under pressure, it would appear unlikely that a nonsuperconducting simple metal, like any of the alkali metals, would ever become superconducting under pressure. Over 30 years ago, however, Wittig [[CITE_124]] demonstrated that at pressures above 7 GPa the alkali metal Cs becomes superconducting near 1.5 K. At first glance this result would appear to contradict our above conclusions, but it does not. At pressures above 7 GPa Cs is no longer a simple metal! Near these pressures [[MATH_125]] transfer occurs as the bottom of the 5[[MATH_126]] band drops below the top of the 6[[MATH_127]] band, thus turning Cs into a transition metal [[CITE_128]]. A similar scenario would be expected for the next lighter alkali metals Rb and K.
chunks.zh: 由于对于简单金属超导体，[[MATH_123]] 在压力下总是\textit{减小}，因此似乎不太可能有任何一种非超导的简单金属（例如任何碱金属）会在压力下变为超导体。然而，30 多年前，Wittig [[CITE_124]] 证明了碱金属 Cs 在高于 7 GPa 的压力下会在 1.5 K 附近变为超导体。乍一看，这一结果似乎与我们上述结论相矛盾，但实际上并非如此。在高于 7 GPa 的压力下，Cs 已不再是一种简单金属！在这些压力附近，5[[MATH_126]] 能带的底部降至 6[[MATH_127]] 能带的顶部之下，从而发生 [[MATH_125]] 转移，使 Cs 转变为一种过渡金属 [[CITE_128]]。对于更轻的碱金属 Rb 和 K，预期也会出现类似的情形。

chunks.en: In this connection the alkali metal Li is of particular interest. Its unoccupied 3[[MATH_129]] band lies far above the Fermi energy; indeed, Li lies two rows up in the periodic table from the 3[[MATH_130]] transition metal series. In this picture, therefore, no pressure-induced superconductivity would be expected in Li, except at pressures well above the 100 GPa range. In 1986 Lin and Dunn [[CITE_131]] did report a possible phase transition in Li under quasihydrostatic pressures above 20 GPa, but the evidence for superconductivity was not unequivocal.
chunks.zh: 在这方面，碱金属 Li 尤其值得关注。其未占据的 3[[MATH_129]] 能带远高于费米能级；事实上，Li 在元素周期表中位于 3[[MATH_130]] 过渡金属系列之上两行。因此，按照这一图像，Li 中不应出现压力诱导的超导电性，除非压力远高于 100 GPa 的范围。1986 年，Lin 和 Dunn [[CITE_131]] 确实报道了 Li 在 20 GPa 以上的准静水压力下可能发生相变，但关于超导电性的证据并不确凿。

chunks.en: In 1998 Neaton and Ashcroft [[CITE_132]] made the alarming prediction that at sufficiently high pressures Li should cease to behave like a simple metal, but rather should show marked deviations from free-electron-like behavior. Because of core overlap the bands near [[MATH_133]] actually become narrower and band gaps increase markedly, thus contradicting basic high-pressure wisdom that under pressure bands broaden and band gaps decrease! This result was mentioned in an earlier paper by Boettger and Trickey [[CITE_134]]. At pressures sufficient to generate overlap of the Li-ion cores, the orthogonality requirements of the valence electrons to the core states leads to a marked enhancement in the pseudopotential and thus in the electron-lattice coupling. This in turn would be expected to generate structural phase transitions to lower symmetry structures and possible superconductivity. Extensive experimental [[CITE_135]] and theoretical [[CITE_136]] investigations of structural phase changes in the alkali metals have confirmed these general expectations. In 2001 Christensen and Novikov [[CITE_137]] predicted from \textit{ab initio} electronic structure calculations that for [[MATH_138]] Li [[MATH_139]] would increase rapidly with pressure to values approaching 80 K. These predictions prompted several experimental groups to search in earnest for superconductivity in Li under pressure.
chunks.zh: 1998 年，Neaton 和 Ashcroft [[CITE_132]] 做出了一个令人震惊的预言：在足够高的压力下，Li 将不再表现为简单金属，而应表现出对类自由电子行为的显著偏离。由于芯态重叠，[[MATH_133]] 附近的能带实际上会变窄，带隙显著增大，这与高压下的基本常识——即在压力下能带会展宽、带隙会减小——相矛盾！这一结果在 Boettger 和 Trickey [[CITE_134]] 更早的一篇论文中曾被提及。在足以使 Li 离子芯发生重叠的压力下，价电子相对于芯态的正交性要求导致赝势显著增强，从而增强了电子-晶格耦合。这反过来又预期会引发向低对称性结构的结构相变以及可能的超导性。对碱金属结构相变的大量实验 [[CITE_135]] 和理论 [[CITE_136]] 研究证实了这些一般性预期。2001 年，Christensen 和 Novikov [[CITE_137]] 通过 \textit{ab initio} 电子结构计算预言，对于 [[MATH_138]]，Li 的 [[MATH_139]] 将随压力迅速增大，达到接近 80 K 的数值。这些预言促使多个实验小组认真地在压力下寻找 Li 中的超导性。

chunks.en: The first group to confirm a superconducting transition in Li was that of Shimizu \textit{et al. }[[CITE_140]] in 2002 in a diamond-anvil cell experiment to 50 GPa. In their electrical resistivity measurement superconductivity appeared at 7.5 K for 30 GPa pressure, rising rapidly to values approaching 20 K; the pressure dependence [[MATH_141]] was combined from four separate experiments and exhibited considerable scatter. A few months later Struzhkin \textit{et al.} [[CITE_142]] measured the [[MATH_143]] susceptibility to 40 GPa and the resistivity to 82 GPa, reporting an onset of superconducting at 10 K for 23 GPa with a rapid rise under pressure to [[MATH_144]] 16 K at 35 GPa.
chunks.zh: 首个确认 Li 中存在超导转变的研究组是 Shimizu \textit{et al. }[[CITE_140]]，他们于 2002 年在金刚石压砧实验中加压至 50 GPa。在其电阻率测量中，超导性在 30 GPa 压力下出现于 7.5 K，并迅速上升至接近 20 K 的数值；压力依赖关系 [[MATH_141]] 由四次独立实验综合得出，并表现出相当大的离散性。数月之后，Struzhkin \textit{et al.} [[CITE_142]] 测量了至 40 GPa 的 [[MATH_143]] 磁化率以及至 82 GPa 的电阻率，报告在 23 GPa 时超导起始温度为 10 K，并在压力下迅速上升，于 35 GPa 时达到 [[MATH_144]] 16 K。

chunks.en: In both these studies no pressure medium was used, the diamond anvils being allowed to press directly onto the Li sample. This raises the question whether shear stresses on the Li in such experiments may have played a role in the reported superconducting transition. Such effects have been well documented. In the first high-pressure ever carried out on a superconductor, Sizoo and Onnes [[CITE_145]] reported for both Sn and In that [[MATH_146]] decreased under hydrostatic pressure, but \textit{increased} if uniaxial pressure was applied. If Li metal is cooled from ambient temperature, it undergoes a martensitic phase transformation at [[MATH_147]] K from the [[MATH_148]] to a [[MATH_149]] low-temperature phase. Under hydrostatic pressure [[MATH_150]] increases at the rate +30 K/GPa [[CITE_151]], but under uniaxial pressure [[MATH_152]] K/GPa [[CITE_153]], a rate 40[[MATH_154]] faster! In the present experiment, in fact, nonhydrostatic shear stresses on the Re gasket resulted in a sharp increase in Re's superconducting transition temperature to 3.5 K, thus preventing the detection of superconductivity from the Li sample at lower temperatures. Further examples of sharply differing hydrostatic versus uniaxial pressure effects on superconductivity are given in Ref. [[CITE_155]]. For this reason we set out to search for superconductivity in Li using the most hydrostatic pressure medium of all, dense He.
chunks.zh: 在这两项研究中均未使用传压介质，金刚石压砧直接压在 Li 样品上。这就提出了一个问题：在此类实验中作用于 Li 上的剪切应力是否在所报道的超导转变中起了作用。此类效应已有充分文献记载。在首次对超导体进行的高压实验中，Sizoo 和 Onnes [[CITE_145]] 报道，对于 Sn 和 In，[[MATH_146]] 在静水压下降低，但在单轴压力下\textit{升高}。如果将金属 Li 从室温冷却，它会在 [[MATH_147]] K 发生马氏体相变，从 [[MATH_148]] 相转变为 [[MATH_149]] 低温相。在静水压下，[[MATH_150]] 以 +30 K/GPa 的速率升高 [[CITE_151]]，但在单轴压力下为 [[MATH_152]] K/GPa [[CITE_153]]，速率快了 40[[MATH_154]]！事实上，在本实验中，Re 垫圈上的非静水剪切应力导致 Re 的超导转变温度急剧升高至 3.5 K，从而阻碍了在更低温度下探测 Li 样品的超导性。更多关于静水压与单轴压力对超导性影响显著不同的例子见文献 [[CITE_155]]。因此，我们着手使用最具静水性的传压介质——致密 He——来寻找 Li 中的超导性。

chunks.en: In Fig. 3 (left) we show the coil arrangement we used for [[MATH_156]] susceptibility measurements in our nonmagnetic BeCu diamond-anvil cell. Two identical coils are shown wound with 60 [[MATH_157]] Cu wire consisting of an outer primary coil (130 turns) and an inner secondary coil (180 turns). One coil is placed around the lower diamond anvil (1/6 carat, 0.5 mm culet) with the compensating coil directly adjacent. Both coils and lead wires are thermally anchored to an insulating board with GE varnish. A preindented Re gasket is placed in both measuring and compensating coils to reduce the background signal in the [[MATH_158]] susceptibility. Before applying pressure, liquid He is filled into the gasket hole to serve as a nearly hydrostatic pressure medium. Further experimental details are given in Ref. [[CITE_159]].
chunks.zh: 在图 3（左）中，我们展示了用于在非磁性 BeCu 金刚石压砧装置中进行 [[MATH_156]] 磁化率测量的线圈布置。图中显示了两个相同的线圈，由 60 [[MATH_157]] 铜线绕制而成，包括一个外部初级线圈（130 匝）和一个内部次级线圈（180 匝）。一个线圈缠绕在下方金刚石压砧（1/6 克拉，0.5 mm 砧面）周围，补偿线圈紧邻其放置。两个线圈及引线均通过 GE 清漆热锚定在绝缘板上。在测量线圈和补偿线圈中均放置了预压痕的 Re 垫片，以降低 [[MATH_158]] 磁化率中的背景信号。施加压力之前，向垫片孔中充入液态 He，作为近似静水压的传压介质。更多实验细节见文献 [[CITE_159]]。

chunks.en: In Fig. 4 we show the superconducting phase diagram for Li metal under nearly hydrostatic pressures to 67 GPa [[CITE_160]]; this diagram differs significantly from the results of the previous studies[[CITE_161]], particularly above 30 GPa. In the first run 25 data points were obtained as a function of both increasing and decreasing pressure. We find that under nearly hydrostatic pressure Li becomes superconducting at [[MATH_162]] 5 K for 20 GPa, [[MATH_163]] increasing initially rapidly with pressure to [[MATH_164]] 14 K at 30 GPa. At this pressure a structural phase transition appears to occur as evidenced by the sharp break in slope [[MATH_165]] At higher pressures [[MATH_166]] passes through a minimum before dropping below 4 K at 67 GPa. Although it is possible that at or above 67 GPa Li has transformed into the paired semiconducting/insulating state envisioned by Neaton and Ashcroft, we have no clear evidence for this. At 67 GPa our Li sample remains opaque to transmitted light in the visible region; from this one can infer that Li is either still a metal or a semiconductor with a band gap less than 1.7 eV. A more complete discussion of these results, including evidence that Li is a type I superconductor, is given in Ref. [[CITE_167]].
chunks.zh: 在图 4 中，我们展示了 Li 金属在接近静水压条件下直至 67 GPa 的超导相图 [[CITE_160]]；该相图与先前研究的结果 [[CITE_161]] 存在显著差异，尤其是在 30 GPa 以上。在第一轮实验中，我们随压力升高和降低共获得了 25 个数据点。我们发现，在接近静水压条件下，Li 在 20 GPa 时于 [[MATH_162]] 5 K 变为超导体，[[MATH_163]] 最初随压力迅速升高，在 30 GPa 时达到 [[MATH_164]] 14 K。在此压力下似乎发生了一次结构相变，其证据是斜率的急剧转折 [[MATH_165]]。在更高压力下，[[MATH_166]] 经过一个极小值，随后在 67 GPa 时降至 4 K 以下。尽管 Li 有可能在 67 GPa 或更高压力下转变为 Neaton 和 Ashcroft 所设想的配对半导体/绝缘态，但我们没有明确的证据支持这一点。在 67 GPa 时，我们的 Li 样品对可见光区域的透射光仍不透明；由此可以推断，Li 要么仍是金属，要么是带隙小于 1.7 eV 的半导体。关于这些结果更完整的讨论，包括 Li 为第一类超导体的证据，见文献 [[CITE_167]]。

chunks.en: Following the experiments on Li metal, two further alkali metals, Na and K, were subjected to nearly hydrostatic dense He pressure in a search for superconductivity. Shi \textit{et al.} [[CITE_168]] have carried out an electronic structure calculation on K and Rb and predict an onset of superconducting near 13 GPa for K and 8 GPa for Rb with a rapid rise in [[MATH_169]] with pressure, in analogy with Li. In our experiment on Na metal to 65 GPa, however, no superconducting transition could be detected above 4 K. K metal also failed to become superconducting above 4 K to 43.5 GPa pressure. In a second experiment on K a nonsuperconducting MoW gasket was used which permitted measurements to lower temperatures. In this experiment no superconductivity was detected in K above 1.5 K to 35 GPa pressure. In a quasihydrostatic experiment to 21 GPa by Ullrich \textit{et al. } [[CITE_170]], no superconductivity was found in Rb above 0.05 K .
chunks.zh: 在 Li 金属实验之后，另外两种碱金属 Na 和 K 被置于近似静水压的致密 He 压力之下，以寻找超导电性。Shi \textit{et al.} [[CITE_168]] 对 K 和 Rb 进行了电子结构计算，并预测 K 在约 13 GPa、Rb 在约 8 GPa 附近开始出现超导电性，且 [[MATH_169]] 随压力迅速上升，与 Li 的情形类似。然而，在我们对 Na 金属进行的高达 65 GPa 的实验中，在 4 K 以上未能探测到超导转变。K 金属在高达 43.5 GPa 的压力下，在 4 K 以上也未能实现超导。在对 K 的第二次实验中，使用了非超导的 MoW 垫圈，从而能够将测量扩展到更低的温度。在该实验中，K 在高达 35 GPa 的压力下，在 1.5 K 以上未探测到超导电性。在 Ullrich \textit{et al. } [[CITE_170]] 进行的一项高达 21 GPa 的准静水压实验中，Rb 在 0.05 K 以上也未发现超导电性。

chunks.en: It would seem almost certain that all alkali metals will become superconducting under sufficient pressure; after all, both the lightest (Li) and heaviest (Cs) alkali metals do become superconducting! Further experiments are underway over expanded temperature/pressure ranges to search for superconductivity in Na, K, and Rb.
chunks.zh: 几乎可以肯定，所有碱金属在足够高的压力下都会变为超导体；毕竟，最轻的（Li）和最重的（Cs）碱金属确实都能实现超导！目前，进一步的实验正在更宽的温度/压力范围内进行，以寻找 Na、K 和 Rb 中的超导性。
